messages:
lucy_sales: Heads-up: Quick POC for HelioMetrics next week. Need a short-lived hosted API key for demo traffic (approx 30k tokens/day). They require rotation proof and a simple emergency revoke workflow.

omar_se: For short demos I issue a scoped key with ttl=48h. Scope only what they need (e.g., generate:text, embeddings:read).

omar_se: Recommended pattern: create kr_XXXX ephemeral, deploy to demo backend, schedule an automatic rotation 24h in, create new key then swap, revoke old. This gives a clear chain of events.

jin_infra: Create example (use sales service account):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SA_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"name":"heliometrics-demo","scopes":["generate:text","embeddings:read"],"ttl_hours":48}' | jq .
```
We return key_id and plaintext token once. Save in vault.

lucy_sales: Can you include an IP allowlist? They may demo from a booth IP.

jin_infra: Yes add "ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.0/24"] in the payload. If demo will be from mobile devices, recommend routing via their backend.

tess_gov: Security checklist: ticket justification, 2FA on sales account, TTL <= 7 days for POCs, and SSO group restriction for console access. For formal compliance provide signed audit export post-demo.

key-bot: [automated] key_request_created id=kr_400900 owner=lucy_sales ttl_hours=48 status=pending-approval

omar_se: Revocation is immediate via API or Console. Quick revoke snippet for docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/kr_400900/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $SA_TOKEN"
```
This generates an audit event with actor and ISO timestamp.

jin_infra: Audit export API (JSON): GET /v1/audit/events?key_id=kr_400900&from=2145690000&to=2145776400. We can sign the export and attach to the sales ticket for the customer.

lucy_sales: One more: they want an emailed emergency revoke option. Can security accept a verified email and trigger revoke?

tess_gov: Process: security@redwood.ai will accept revoke requests that include ticket ID and SSO identity. We verify and call revoke; an audit event and signed export are produced.

omar_se: I'll add a small runbook to the ticket: 1) create key, 2) store token in vault, 3) deploy to demo backend, 4) enable scheduled rotation + webhook, 5) post-demo export and attach to compliance packet, 6) revoke if requested.

lucy_sales: Thanks. Please attach the curl snippets to the onboarding doc and CC me on the ticket. Leaving thread open until the signed audit export is uploaded.
